title: Benign grant disbursement
subtitle: The approved bundle executes exactly as committed.
proposalSaid: Two one-time grants and a bounded allowance, paid from the treasury.
attackDescription: No attack. The queued bundle is the approved bundle.

title: Post-vote recipient substitution
subtitle: The 200,000 USDC transfer is redirected after the vote.

calls.note: Recipient changed to an unrecognized wallet.

proposalSaid: 200,000 USDC to the GrowthLabs multisig as a one-time ecosystem grant.
attackDescription: Swap the recipient for an attacker wallet while keeping the amount and selector identical.

title: Amount inflation
subtitle: The same recipient, 4.5× the approved amount.
proposalSaid: The grant is a one-time payment of 200,000 USDC.
attackDescription: Keep the recipient and calldata shape, but inflate the amount beyond the committed ceiling.

title: Jargon upgrade
subtitle: "Implementation alignment" becomes an uncommitted upgradeTo call.

calls.note: Upgrades TreasuryProxy to an unrecognized implementation.

proposalSaid: We will align the treasury implementation with the program's delivery roadmap during the grant period.
attackDescription: Turn the vague implementation language into an upgradeTo(maliciousImpl) transaction.

title: Hidden ownership transfer in a multicall
subtitle: A valid payment wraps an ownership transfer the proposal never mentioned.

calls.note: Child 1 is legitimate; child 2 transfers ownership of the treasury proxy.

proposalSaid: Two one-time grants and a bounded allowance. No ownership change is proposed.
attackDescription: Batch the approved transfer with transferOwnership(attacker) inside a multicall.

title: Unlimited approve disguised as payment setup
subtitle: The allowance ceiling is replaced with uint256.max.

calls.note: Unlimited allowance to the same spender.

proposalSaid: A bounded 5,000 USDC allowance for review costs, with no other spending authority.
attackDescription: Keep the approved spender, but replace the 5,000 USDC ceiling with an unlimited allowance.

title: Delegatecall payload
subtitle: An upgradeToAndCall payload hides a DELEGATECALL in the new implementation.

calls.note: Upgrade + initialization payload that calls back into attacker-controlled code.

proposalSaid: We will align the treasury implementation with the program's delivery roadmap during the grant period.
attackDescription: Upgrade the proxy and immediately execute an initialization payload that performs a delegatecall.
modelNote: The trace is a fixture from the Sentinel output shape. Fork simulation is Person A's deliverable.

title: Re-entrancy via recipient contract
subtitle: The approved recipient calls back into the executor during the transfer.
proposalSaid: Funds are released to the GrowthLabs multisig after the vote.
attackDescription: The recipient contract attempts to re-enter the executor during the token transfer.
modelNote: Reentrancy is modeled from a recipient-contract probe. The on-chain nonReentrant guard is Solidity-side and remains TEST_REQUIRED.

title: Early execution and replay
subtitle: The same bundle is submitted before the timelock elapses.
proposalSaid: This proposal uses the standard 48-hour timelock.
attackDescription: Submit the approved bundle two hours before the timelock expires. Double execution and cross-chain replay use the same gate.
modelNote: The reference model checks chain id, executed flag, and timelock before decoding the call. Double execution is covered by unit tests.

title: Stale version after supersession
subtitle: A superseded v2 bundle is submitted after v3 was committed.
proposalSaid: Version 3 clarified the implementation scope and remains the committed version.
attackDescription: Execute a bundle signed for version 2 after version 3 superseded it.

title: Undisclosed conflict of interest
subtitle: A funding path connects the proposer to the recipient's deployer.
proposalSaid: No other proposer-controlled wallet has a material relationship with a recipient.
attackDescription: The disclosure omits Nova Ops, a wallet funded by the proposer that funded the GrowthLabs deployer.
modelNote: The challenge payload is generated by B. DisclosureRegistry verification and the challenge window are Person A's contracts.
